title: RaceTrack — Ranking Race Studio
description: Build bump charts and animated bar-chart races from your own data, then export a PNG, WebM, or share link.
concept: A data-visualization mini-app with two linked chart modes over the same dataset: a static bump chart tracing rank changes over time, and an animated bar-chart race that eases bars between ranks as you scrub or play. Comes with 3 sample datasets, a CSV import + inline data editor, 4 color themes, and export to PNG/WebM/CSV/JSON plus a shareable URL.
features: Two visualization modes: bump (ranking) chart and animated bar-chart race sharing one dataset
CSV import and an inline text data editor for building your own dataset by hand
Playback transport: play/pause, scrub, and 0.5×–4× speed control driving the race animation
4 color themes and hover/tap tooltips with per-series highlighting on the bump chart
Export to PNG snapshot, WebM video recording of the race, CSV, and JSON, plus a shareable URL-hash link
localStorage gallery for saving/loading named datasets, with autosave of last session state

interaction.mouse: Hover bump-chart nodes to see values and highlight a series; drag the scrub bar to move through time
interaction.click: Toggle Bump/Race mode, play/pause the race, switch dataset/theme, open the data editor, gallery, or export menu
interaction.touch: Tap nodes for tooltips on mobile, drag the scrub slider, tap toolbar buttons — all controls are touch-sized
interaction.keyboard: Left/Right arrow keys scrub the timeline; Space toggles play/pause
